versions.changelog: Add freestyle Sound Scenes workflows, prompt optimization, scene management, estimates, and guarded audio generation.
Adds language-aware Voice Canvas projects, credit estimation, background rendering, progress recovery, and merged WAV downloads.
Fix required Idempotency-Key headers for clone and synthesis requests.

Uydi Voice skill 1.0.0 — Initial public release:

- Enables natural-language AI voice design, user voice cloning, and high-quality text-to-speech with the Uydi platform.
- Simple, zero-dependency Node.js CLI with OAuth authentication via web or device code.
- Manage voices, credits, and synthesis history directly from the command line.
- Supports secure voice slot/credit usage and user-initiated browser approvals.
- Detailed CLI commands for all voice and narration workflows.
